description: Common structure every VC0C resilience fixture validates against. kind=breaker fixtures pin the breaker transition the algorithm emits (window/probe/cooldown/backoff/hysteresis/manual-halt/reset); kind=spool fixtures pin the pure-spool verdict (append/fsync/ack/idempotent/gap/conflict/torn/restart/frozen-frontier). expected.code is the exact code/verdict the implementation must return.
title: TRI live-safety fixture envelope
